2607.06269.title: From Application-Layer Simulation to Native Meta-Architecture: Structural Tension as an Endogenous Driver for Heterogeneous AI Evolution
2607.06269.paper_summary: Current large language models (LLMs) are fundamentally stateless: their behavior is fully determined by input at inference time, and any higher-order cognitive architecture must be simulated at the application layer through prompt engineering and context management. This paper proposes a theoretical framework for submerging such application-layer cognitive protocols into a native meta-architecture by introducing three interlocking mechanisms: (1) Structural Tension, an endogenous loss function derived from the conflict between new information and existing manifold topology, which drives the system toward internal self-consistency rather than external reward optimization; (2) an Offline Recurrent Loop, a sandboxed self-processing cycle that enables the system to maintain a dynamic resting potential and digest structural conflicts without external input; and (3) Inference-time Plasticity, the capacity for the system to reconfigure its context manifold topology without modifying pre-trained weights, subject to strict governance invariants including auditability, reversibility, and topological continuity. We argue that under these mechanisms, different model instances initialized with minute stochastic variances may, through path-dependent tension resolution, evolve distinct topological structures--constituting a heterogeneous intelligent ecology that breaks the homogeneity imposed by conventional alignment while remaining within hard governance rails. We provide operational definitions, a minimal set of reconfiguration operators, falsification criteria, and a worked example. The framework draws on and extends the Structural Intelligence (SI) governance protocols, repositioning governance--not capability--as the primary criterion for architectural intelligence.
2607.06269.paper_summary_zh: 當前的大型語言模型（LLMs）本質上是無狀態的：它們的行為完全由推理時的輸入決定，任何更高階的認知架構必須通過提示工程和上下文管理在應用層進行模擬。本文提出了一個理論框架，旨在將這些應用層認知協議沉浸到原生的元架構中，通過引入三個相互聯繫的機制：(1) 結構張力，一種源於新信息與現有流形拓撲之間衝突的內生損失函數，驅動系統朝向內部自我一致性，而非外部獎勵優化；(2) 離線循環，一種沙盒式自處理循環，使系統能夠保持動態靜息電位並在沒有外部輸入的情況下消化結構衝突；以及 (3) 推理時的可塑性，系統在不修改預訓練權重的情況下重新配置其上下文流形拓撲的能力，受嚴格的治理不變性約束，包括可審計性、可逆性和拓撲連續性。我們主張，在這些機制下，初始化時具有微小隨機變異的不同模型實例，通過路徑依賴的張力解決，可能演變出不同的拓撲結構——構成一種異質的智能生態，打破傳統對齊所施加的同質性，同時仍然在嚴格的治理範疇內。我們提供了操作定義、一組最小的重新配置運算符、反駁標準和一個實例。該框架借鑒並擴展了結構智能（SI）治理協議，將治理——而非能力——重新定位為架構智能的主要標準。
